theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (V : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)) (θ : Measure (Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N)), IsProbabilityMeasure θ → (∀ᵐ g ∂θ, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint g * g = 1 ∧ ∀ x ∈ Vᗮ, g x = x) → (∀ k : Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint k * k = 1 → (∀ x ∈ Vᗮ, k x = x) → Measure.map (fun g ↦ k * g) θ = θ ∧ Measure.map (fun g ↦ g * k) θ = θ) → 0 < μHE[n] {x : Rn N | x ∈ V ∧ ‖x‖ = 1} → μHE[n] {x : Rn N | x ∈ V ∧ ‖x‖ = 1} < ∞ → ∀ ζ ∈ V, ‖ζ‖ = 1 → ∀ Y : Set (Rn N), MeasurableSet Y → μHE[n] (Y ∩ {x : Rn N | x ∈ V ∧ ‖x‖ = 1}) = 0 → θ {g | g ζ ∈ Y} = 0
